summary: Iteration 13 — Footer 5-columns + CMS pages (public + admin). All 5 requested flows PASS. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests green (settings footer fields, /api/pages/{slug} 200/404, admin pages CRUD, PUT /settings for footer). Frontend: public site-footer renders 4 news links, 8 help links (Confidentialité + CGV included), 4 socials, Google Maps address link, /visite-360 tour link, footer-about text. FAQ link routes to /page/faq with cms-page/title/content; /page/inexistant-xyz shows cms-page-notfound. Admin 'Footer & Pages' tab: footer-about edit + news-label edit + news-add + news-enabled-1 toggle all correctly reflected on public / after refresh (disabled link hidden). CMS: page-new + page-title-input + page-slug-input + page-content-input + page-save creates a new page visible in pages-list AND accessible on /page/{slug}; page-edit-faq + page-save propagates content to /page/faq; page-del-{slug} removes it (public GET 404 verified). No console errors specific to this feature.
critical_code_review_comments: Footer.jsx uses whatsapp_url with fallback to whatsapp_number-derived wa.me URL — correct.
CmsPage.jsx correctly resets state on slug change (setPage(null); setNotFound(false) inside useEffect).
PageEditModal correctly toggles between POST /admin/pages (new) and PUT /admin/pages/{id} (edit) via presence of f.id.
FooterPanel.save() calls refresh() on SettingsContext so public site updates without hard reload — verified working.

Minor: the review-request mentioned /page/wellness-pharma-dz — no such seeded slug exists (that string is the preview host); tested edit propagation via /page/faq instead which is functionally equivalent.
Admin.jsx is now 1071 lines; approaching the >700 threshold — consider splitting FooterPanel/PageEditModal/LinksEditor into their own files for maintainability (non-blocking).
